summary.content:
Today's selection covers 82 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 51 on Artificial Intelligence and 10 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI ends Disney partnership as it closes Sora video-making app
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Manager of botnet used in ransomware attacks gets 2 years in prison
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, The Verge, BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 59 articles published in the last 24 hours
